sentences.text: Bentley Motors Limited -LRB- -LSB- ˈbɛntli -RSB- -RRB- is a British manufacturer and marketer of luxury cars and SUVs -- and a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG since 1998 .	Volkswagen AG	Volkswagen AG

Headquartered in Crewe , England , the company was founded as Bentley Motors Limited by W. O. Bentley in 1919 in Cricklewood , North London -- and became widely known for winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1924 , 1927 , 1928 , 1929 , 1930 , and 2003 .	W. O. Bentley	W. O. Bentley	Crewe	Crewe	24 Hours of Le Mans	24 Hours of Le Mans	1924	1924 24 Hours of Le Mans	1927	1927 24 Hours of Le Mans	1928	1928 24 Hours of Le Mans	1929	1929 24 Hours of Le Mans	1930	1930 24 Hours of Le Mans	2003	2003 24 Hours of Le Mans

Prominent models extend from the historic sports-racing Bentley 4 1/2 Litre and Bentley Speed Six ; the more recent Bentley R Type Continental , Bentley Turbo R , and Bentley Arnage ; to its current model line -- including the Continental Flying Spur , Continental GT , Bentley Bentayga and the Mulsanne -- which are marketed worldwide , with China its largest market as of November 2012 . Today most Bentleys are assembled at the company 's Crewe factory , with a small number assembled at Volkswagen 's Dresden factory Germany , and with bodies for the Continental manufactured in Zwickau and the Bentayga manufactured at the Volkswagen Bratislava Plant . The joining and eventual separation of Bentley and Rolls-Royce follows a series of mergers and acquisitions , beginning with the 1931 purchase by Rolls-Royce of Bentley , then in receivership .	Rolls-Royce	Rolls-Royce Limited

In 1971 , Rolls-Royce itself was forced into receivership and the UK government nationalised the company -- splitting into two companies the aerospace division -LRB- Rolls-Royce Plc -RRB- and automotive -LRB- Rolls-Royce Motors Limited -RRB- divisions -- the latter retaining the Bentley subdivision .	Rolls-Royce	Rolls-Royce Limited
Rolls-Royce Motors was subsequently sold to engineering conglomerate , Vickers and in 1998 , Vickers sold Rolls-Royce to Volkswagen AG .	Volkswagen AG	Volkswagen AG	Rolls-Royce	Rolls-Royce Limited

Intellectual property rights to both the name Rolls-Royce as well as the company 's logo had been retained not by Rolls-Royce Motors , but by aerospace company , Rolls-Royce Plc , which had continued to license both to the automotive division .	Rolls-Royce	Rolls-Royce Limited

Thus the sale of `` Rolls-Royce '' to VW included the Bentley name and logos , vehicle designs , model nameplates , production and administrative facilities , the Spirit of Ecstasy and Rolls-Royce grille shape trademarks -LRB- subsequently sold to BMW by VW -RRB- -- but not the rights to the Rolls-Royce name or logo .
